name: goal-loop-addon
description: Claude Code add-on for the goal-loop skill: a loop.sh wrapper that defaults the builder to a fresh `claude -p`, a PreToolUse hook that enforces the Default-FAIL contract (state.json is written only by verify.sh), and SessionStart/Stop hooks for active goal-loop state. All shell + jq, no Python. The goal-loop skill itself is distributed separately via the skills CLI and runs without this add-on.
